offering_description.value: The company builds and sells new homes to entry-level and move-up buyers. It acquires land and manages construction, then sells homes through community sales centers and online. Its subsidiaries offer mortgage, title, and homeowners insurance services.

primary_services.value: mortgage origination; title and settlement services; homeowners insurance brokerage

end_markets.value: new residential housing; home purchase financing; real estate settlement; homeowners insurance

revenue_model.value: product sales: completed new homes sold at closing; service fees: mortgage origination, title and settlement; other: sales of originated mortgages to secondary-market purchasers; commissions or management fees: commissions on homeowners insurance policies placed with carriers
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; other; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: other: acquires land and manages construction of new homes sold to homebuyers; financial intermediary: originates homebuyer mortgages for resale and places homeowners policies with insurers; service provider: uses property records and transaction documents to provide title and settlement services to homebuyers

geography_served.value: US national: United States, including the West, Mountain states, Texas, Midwest, and Southeast

specialization.value: related lines: entry-level and move-up homes, mortgage origination, title and settlement, and homeowners insurance brokerage

distribution_channels.value: own locations: sales centers and model homes in company developments; online: company websites offering home search and online purchase options; agents / brokers: independent real estate agents representing homebuyers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State mortgage, title, and insurance licensing, federal consumer lending rules, and local building permits and codes.

notes: The exact current list of states served is uncertain.
